description: Astrology sky today (no birth data): planet positions, retrogrades and the Moon phase now, plus the exact times of the next ingresses, Mercury retrograde and other stations, new and full moons and planetary aspects over the coming days. For agents and bots that follow the sky itself (market timing, daily content, alerts): positions with retrograde flags and the Moon's phase and illumination at a moment (default: now, UTC), then every sign ingress, retrograde/direct station, lunation (new, quarter, full) and major aspect between the planets over the next 1-90 days, each to the minute. Tropical or sidereal. Pass 'datetime' for a reproducible call. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/western/sky (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

inputSchema.description: All optional: the moment (default now, UTC). A local time needs a timezone or coordinates.

ambiguous_time.description: Which occurrence to use when a local time happens twice (DST fall-back).

datetime.description: Local birth date-time, ISO 8601: '1990-05-15T14:30' (local clock time at the place) or with an explicit offset '1990-05-15T14:30:00+02:00'. Alternative: 'date' + 'time'.

days.description: How many days ahead to list events. Example: 30.

time.description: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, 24 h. Omit if unknown (computed at 12:00 with a TIME_UNKNOWN warning).

time_basis.description: What the given clock time is: civil wall-clock (default), UTC, Local Mean Time, or true (apparent) solar time.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates, with the historical offset (DST, Local Mean Time) of that date.

name: sky_today

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

counts.description: Number of events of each type.

events.description: Upcoming events in time order, each with 'type' (ingress, station, lunation, aspect), its details and 'exact_utc'.

now.description: The sky at the moment: 'points' (positions, signs, speeds, retrograde flags), 'retrograde' (bodies retrograde now) and 'moon' (elongation, phase name, illumination, waxing).

settings.description: Settings applied: zodiac (and ayanamsa), days ahead, the bodies and aspects searched, and the precision of event times.

subject.description: The resolved input: 'time' (local input, time zone and historical UTC offset, UT, Julian days, Delta T) and, when given, 'location' (latitude, longitude).

warnings.description: Notes on the input or the calculation (for example an assumed noon for an unknown birth time). Present only when there is something to say.

title: Sky today
